contract_provenance.claim: Shared is_code_file classifier separates executable scripts from static markdown, CSV, and config deliverables.
Container-to-host path translation exists so host interpreters can execute written scripts while preserving static output artifacts.

minimal_reproduction.input_summary: Write dictated README.md and CSV deliverables containing /mnt/user-data/outputs/results.csv via LocalSandbox.write_file.
minimal_reproduction.expected_on_contract: Non-executable deliverables preserve virtual /mnt/... paths byte-for-byte on disk.
minimal_reproduction.observed_on_base: Stored bytes are rewritten to host mount paths while read_file masks the mutation (7 failed on f41670016).

normal_behavior_counterexample.normal_input_summary: Write .py, .sh, .awk, and shebang-only executable scripts referencing /mnt/user-data/outputs/out.txt.
normal_behavior_counterexample.rationale: Disabling path translation globally would break #1935 host script execution and .awk interpreter invocations.

maintainer_feedback.maintainer_notes: Review rounds caught .awk exclusion in is_code_file and blocking FIFO open during append classification; fixed with O_NONBLOCK and suffixless FIFO test, merged as 228913b6b.
requested_evidence: Guard destination sniffing with O_NONBLOCK and S_ISREG on POSIX FIFOs
Add suffixless FIFO append regression so O_NONBLOCK mutation turns red
maintainer_feedback.rule_update_derived: Require non-blocking O_NONBLOCK/S_ISREG checks and interpreter-extension counterexamples whenever a patch inspects destination files before writing.

contract_provenance.claim: _is_blank_paragraph already preserves zero-run <w:p> blank lines to retain paragraph separation while excluding media-bearing paragraphs.
OOXML WordprocessingML <w:p> paragraphs carrying only whitespace <w:t> or <w:br/> runs represent blank lines, whereas <w:instrText> represents active field codes.

minimal_reproduction.input_summary: Parse a DOCX containing two text paragraphs separated by a blank paragraph carrying a space or <w:br/> run.
minimal_reproduction.expected_on_contract:
Blank paragraph separator is preserved ('Paragraph one.


Paragraph two.').
minimal_reproduction.observed_on_base: Blank paragraph with any <w:r> child is dropped, collapsing chunks into 'Paragraph one.\nParagraph two.'.

normal_behavior_counterexample.normal_input_summary: Parse a DOCX paragraph containing an OOXML <w:instrText> field instruction without visible <w:t> text.
normal_behavior_counterexample.rationale: Checking only empty paragraph.text would misclassify active field-code paragraphs as blank lines.

contract_provenance.claim: DocumentStore Protocol mandates synchronous filter_documents; filter_documents_async is an optional async extension.
Sibling async components explicitly check async method availability on custom sync-only DocumentStore implementations.

minimal_reproduction.input_summary: Run FilterRetriever.run_async, AutoMergingRetriever.run_async, and SentenceWindowRetriever.run_async with a sync-only DocumentStore.
minimal_reproduction.expected_on_contract: Retrievers fall back cleanly to worker-thread execution of synchronous filter_documents.
minimal_reproduction.observed_on_base: Unconditional filter_documents_async lookup raises AttributeError on sync-only stores.

normal_behavior_counterexample.normal_input_summary: Run async retrievers against InMemoryDocumentStore implementing native filter_documents_async.
normal_behavior_counterexample.rationale: Async-capable stores must continue executing native filter_documents_async without unnecessary thread-pool hops.

maintainer_feedback.rule_update_derived: When sibling components guard an optional async protocol method, check whether upstream prefers thread-pool fallback over fail-fast TypeError and validate Reno notes.

contract_provenance.claim: Async project document reads must release underlying file handles deterministically across task cancellation boundaries.

minimal_reproduction.input_summary: Cancel async project document read immediately after open, during in-flight read, and during in-flight close.
minimal_reproduction.expected_on_contract: File handle closes cleanly and close settles before cancellation propagates.
minimal_reproduction.observed_on_base: All 3 cancellation windows leaked open handles or raced close against active reads on a1b89d043.

normal_behavior_counterexample.normal_input_summary: Uncancelled sequential and concurrent project document reads return full bytes and close handles.
normal_behavior_counterexample.rationale: Shielding close cleanup must not alter normal return payloads or swallow non-cancellation I/O errors.

contract_provenance.claim: MAX_FILE_PARSE_INPUT_TOKENS = 256000 documents the aggregate token ceiling for parsed file prompts.
_build_page_texts enforces MIN_PER_PAGE_TOKENS = 256 per page without bounding total token count across many pages.

minimal_reproduction.input_summary: Pass 300 dense identifier pages or 1100 short pages into SplitPdfBlock._build_page_texts.
minimal_reproduction.expected_on_contract: Aggregate prompt payload stays within MAX_FILE_PARSE_INPUT_TOKENS (256000) or rejects oversized PDFs explicitly.
minimal_reproduction.observed_on_base: Produces 693300 tokens for 300 dense pages and 275000 tokens for 1100 short pages (2 failed on b04c3f7fb4).

normal_behavior_counterexample.normal_input_summary: Pass a standard 2-page PDF within token budget into _build_page_texts.
normal_behavior_counterexample.rationale: Baseline 2-page PDFs preserve full text and page markers at 16 tokens; choosing rejection vs smaller excerpts is a product decision.

contract_provenance.claim: Model selection directives must distinguish explicit configured model switches from ordinary task prose containing the word 'model'.
Configured model catalog names and aliases define valid model targets at runtime.

minimal_reproduction.input_summary: Prompt 'Use a regression model to analyze the report' against a standard GPT/Claude model catalog.
minimal_reproduction.expected_on_contract: Treated as normal task text (status='none', scope=None).
minimal_reproduction.observed_on_base: Broad use..to regex captures 'a regression model' as an unavailable LLM on 68c9fce5c4.

normal_behavior_counterexample.normal_input_summary: Prompts 'Use the Claude model for this turn: summarize', 'Use a causal model to analyze the report', and 'Use a data model to design a database' (with data-chat configured).
normal_behavior_counterexample.rationale: Determiner filters (d67512b050) break explicit 'the/my Claude model' controls, while static noun word-lists (2bc504b9ba) fail on unseen adjectives and catalog token overlap.
